name: Tipalti
description: Tipalti is a finance automation platform for accounts payable and global mass payments, letting finance teams pay suppliers, freelancers, and partners across many countries and currencies alongside procurement, expense, and treasury management.
best_for: Mid-market and enterprise finance teams that need to automate accounts payable and pay a high volume of suppliers, freelancers, or partners across many countries and currencies.
pros: Mass payments reach 200+ countries and territories in 120+ currencies via 50+ payment methods
Published starting prices ($99/month for Accounts Payable, $249/month for Mass Payments) with unlimited users included on entry plans
SOC 2 Type II audited annually, with reports available to customers on request
cons: Final pricing depends on transaction volume, number of legal entities, and enabled modules, so a full quote requires talking to sales
More complex environments may require additional professional services fees
No self-serve numeric pricing is published for Procurement, Expenses, or Treasury add-on modules
features: Accounts payable automation: supplier management, AI-assisted invoice capture and PO matching, approval workflows, and payment reconciliation
Mass payments to 200+ countries and territories in 120+ currencies via 50+ payment methods, with a self-service payee portal and tax-form (W-9/W-8) collection
Procurement: purchase-order management, approval workflows, and intake management
Expense management: receipt capture from mobile and web apps, spend limits and custom policies, and global reimbursements to 200 countries in 120+ currencies
Treasury management: cash visibility and forecasting
AI agents for invoice capture, PO matching, reporting, bill approvals, purchase requests, tax-form processing, ERP sync resolution, and expense receipt scanning
Integrations with Oracle NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, SAP Business One, Sage, Intuit QuickBooks, and Xero

tiers.name: Accounts Payable
tiers.notes: Starting price. Includes unlimited users, a self-service supplier portal, and core automation features; actual cost also depends on transaction volume and enabled modules.

tiers.name: Mass Payments
tiers.notes: Starting price. Includes unlimited users, a self-service payee portal, and core automation features; actual cost also depends on transaction volume and enabled modules.

tiers.name: Custom quote
tiers.notes: Full pricing depends on per-invoice/per-payment transaction fees, number of legal entities, and which modules (Procurement, Expenses, Treasury) are enabled; complex environments may add professional-services fees.

alternatives.name: BILL
alternatives.description: A financial operations platform combining a free corporate card (BILL Spend & Expense) with paid accounts payable and receivable automation.
alternatives.best_for: SMBs and accounting firms wanting free card-based spend management alongside subscription, per-user AP/AR automation.
strengths: BILL Spend & Expense has no per-user software fees
Deep two-way sync with QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, and Sage Intacct
Transparent per-user AP & AR pricing starting at $49/user/month

alternatives.name: Ramp
alternatives.description: A spend management platform combining a fee-free corporate card with AI-driven expense, AP, and procurement automation.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses wanting a free corporate card paired with automated accounts-payable workflows and zero AP processing fees.
strengths: Free plan with no annual fees or interest charges on the card
Zero processing fees on domestic ACH, check, and card AP payments
Native bidirectional sync with QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, and Sage Intacct
